title: Camp Maranatha
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: In 1972, Chris and Brenda Edmunds, desiring to see God transform the hearts of individuals and families in a context of a camp experience, founded Camp Maranatha. The name Maranatha comes from the Aramaic phrase meaning “our Lord has come” and “come, oh Lord.” This was their prayer.
